label: complete_policy
reason: The page states collection (email address, phone number, usage data, cookies), use (provide and improve the Service) and sharing (service providers, Google Analytics, legal disclosure), and choices (refusing cookies in the browser, the Google Analytics opt-out add-on), so the empty Contact Us heading is not needed for the third item. A generator policy with the organization's name, COMPackage Corp., filled in counts as complete_policy.

label: not_policy

The rubric's generator rule requires the organization's name to be filled in, and a template with an unfilled organization name is not_policy.

label: partial_policy

label: not_policy
reason: The page is a /tag/privacy/ archive whose text holds only site headings, a do-not-sell link and a cookie consent banner, so the main content states no collection, no use or sharing, and no rights, retention or contact for the organization. label: not_policy
reason: The text states collection (names, emails, dates of birth, location, IP addresses), use and disclosure, and retention, rights and privacy@oldview.com, but the organization (Provider) is the unfilled placeholder "[Your Company Name/Legal Entity Name]", with further placeholders for company, address and ABN. label: partial_policy

The page also says the full GDPR policy is available on request, so it is a short notice that points to the full policy elsewhere: partial_policy.

label: complete_policy

label: partial_policy
